author: Mark Atwood
text: ADJUDICATED (2026-08-31, spec/decisions.jsonl 'unicast-dio-admission'): option-A — multicast-only DIO delivery. send_dio() always targets ff02::1a; the authenticated-DIO admission gate (rejects unicast-destination DIOs) STANDS. Implementation path for the 7 red tests: (1) receive.rs:578 unicast-DIS response (send_dio(source)) becomes a multicast DIO emission (or is removed if spec 09 has no solicited-unicast contract — check spec 09 13.x); (2) tests.rs join_leaf helper delivers the root DIO via multicast instead of unicast; (3) routing::tests::nonzero_target_flags InvalidOptionLength failure is SEPARATE (DAO Target-option length drift, b7z9.3 thread). Reference: spec/decisions.jsonl ground truth.
